headline_stat.name: place cells (excitatory units passing shuffle test)

justification.dataset: DANDI 000044 Achilles CA1 linear-track session is the canonical place-cell dataset, correct species, region, and paradigm.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via remfile, restricted to MazeEpoch with a >5 cm/s run mask, explicit cell-type and spike-count filtering, and correct spike-to-position alignment.
justification.analysis: Skaggs spatial information with a proper 200-iteration circular time-shift null, per-unit 95th-percentile significance, direction-split maps, and a Poisson B-spline GLM cross-check.
justification.correctness: All headline numbers (83/120, median SI 0.936 vs 0.012, median direction r=0.27) reproduce from the committed output, are internally consistent across figures, and are physically possible.
justification.figures: Figures clearly show the effect with labeled units and sample sizes, and example cells are chosen to tile the track by spatial-information strength rather than a flattering criterion.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate to a genuinely clean, strong result with nothing misrepresented, but the write-up states no specific limitation (single session, edge-of-track fields), capping it at 3.
justification.verdict: A correct, well-controlled, and cleanly presented demonstration of hippocampal place cells that I would accept as-is.
